title: CollectionJob.results
description: Structured per-level result log for one collector run. Top-level keys are the three severity buckets; each holds an ordered list of entry objects appended by the tap_cares.results.record_* helpers.

site.description: UUIDv7 hardcoded at the helper callsite. Uniquely identifies a single record_* invocation in source. Generated via scripts/uuid7. Grep the codebase for this value to find the exact line that emitted the entry.

code.description: Machine-readable category in UPPER_SNAKE. Stable across runs and rewordings; what programmatic filtering / future Action rules key off of.

message.description: Human-readable run-specific prose. Includes specifics (counts, ratios, fragments) that vary per run; the code stays stable while the message describes the particular occurrence.

context.description: Free-form structured payload. Empty object when no extra context is needed. Collector-defined shape; consumers should treat unrecognized keys as opaque.
